prompt: Create ONE single image, 4:3 aspect ratio: a 2x2 grid of 4 SEPARATE illustrations (2 columns, 2 rows) for a children's picture book, all panels exactly the same size and perfectly aligned, plain white gutters between and around the panels, no frames, no captions, no text, letters or numbers anywhere. Style: Children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolor and gouache with gentle pencil lines, warm golden light, bright friendly palette, rounded friendly faces with expressive eyes, present-day Israel: apartments with balconies, kindergartens, moshav fields, Jerusalem stone, a warm Jewish family home (Shabbat candles, mezuzah, bookshelf with holy books). Calm, warm, safe mood. HEAD COVERING RULE for every panel: every man and every boy (including sons, shepherds, servants, neighbors and children) ALWAYS has his head covered, never bare: a kippah (skullcap) in modern or sages-era scenes, a tallit worn over the head, or in ancient scenes the hood or corner of his robe/cloak drawn over his head or a head-cloth tied with a cord. This overrides any mention of hair in a character description (the hair may show beneath the covering). Women and girls keep their head scarves or coverings as described. Keep every character exactly the same in every panel where they appear: Yael: Girl about 5 years old, small, light olive skin, rosy cheeks, shoulder-length wavy brown hair loose for bedtime, big hazel eyes, navy-blue long-sleeved pajamas with little yellow stars; signature item: a soft brown teddy bear with a light-blue ribbon around its neck; Ima: Yael's mother, early 30s, slim, light olive skin, warm brown eyes, her hair fully tucked under a soft teal headscarf tied at the back, long-sleeved cream knit sweater and a long grey skirt, a thin gold ring; signature item: the teal headscarf; Moshe: Very old man of about 120, slender, long flowing white beard and white hair, kind tired brown eyes, warm olive skin, simple light cream linen robe with a sand-colored sash, plain undyed head cloth, sandals, holds a tall plain wooden shepherd's staff. No glow or rays around his head. Panels in reading order: 1 BOOK COVER: Cozy children's bedroom at night: Yael sits up in bed holding her teddy bear, her right hand gently covering her eyes, while Ima sits on the edge of the bed smiling tenderly beside her. A small yellow lamp glows, stars twinkle through the window over Jerusalem-stone rooftops, and a silver mezuzah is clearly visible on the doorpost. Soft warm light, calm and loving. 2 Night has fallen over an Israeli apartment; through the window, balconies and stars. Yael in her star pajamas climbs happily into her warm bed, toothbrush just put away, teddy bear tucked under her arm. A bookshelf with holy books, a small night lamp, and a silver mezuzah on the door frame. Wide shot of the cozy room, gentle blue night outside and golden light inside. 3 Ima sits down on the edge of the bed and leans toward Yael with a soft questioning smile. Yael, tucked under her blanket with her teddy, places her right hand over her eyes, ready and serious. Medium shot at bed level, warm lamp light on their faces, the doorway with its mezuzah softly visible behind. 4 Quiet sacred moment: Yael and Ima side by side, both covering their eyes with their right hands, lips softly moving together. The room is hushed and dim, the small lamp casting a warm soft glow across the blanket. Close, symmetrical framing of the two faces, peaceful and focused.
